name: Grassy atoll
slug: An unnamed flat island of rolling green plains, labeled the grassy atoll on some maps.
description: A flat island of rolling green plains, about the same size as the island used for comparison. Some maps label it the grassy atoll. Elrus says it has no real name.

log.summary: One of the cave etchings shows this island. Elrus identifies it by the map label grassy atoll and says the place itself has no real name.
